Metadata.title: Parts Tracker
Metadata.description: Track PC part prices across the shops PCPartPicker doesn't cover.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Cheapest in-stock prices across your merchants, updated on a schedule.

Admin.title: Admin

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use GitHub, Google or a one-time link sent to your email.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
signIn.invited: You've been invited. Sign in with the email the invite was sent to.

errors.invite_required: Sign-up is by invitation only. Ask an admin for an invite.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account ({email}) was created. An admin needs to approve it before you can use Parts Tracker; you'll be able to sign in normally once that happens.

magicLink.subject: Your Parts Tracker sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Parts Tracker
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magicLink.footer: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.

invite.subject: You're invited to Parts Tracker
invite.heading: You're invited to Parts Tracker
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to track PC part prices with Parts Tracker. Sign in with this email address to accept; the invite expires in 7 days.
invite.footer: If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore this email.
